statement: A rectangular sheet of metal $16$ cm by $10$ cm has a square of side $x$ cm cut from each corner. The sides are then folded up to make an open box. Find the value of $x$ that gives the box of maximum volume, and find this maximum volume.
solution: The box has volume $V=x(16-2x)(10-2x)=4x^{3}-52x^{2}+160x$. Then $V'=12x^{2}-104x+160=4(x-2)(3x-20)$. The only critical point with $0<x<5$ is $x=2$, and $V''<0$ there, so it gives the maximum volume $V=2\times12\times6=144$ cm$^{3}$.
hints: Express the volume as a function of $x$.
Reject the inadmissible root and compute the volume.
